title: In-Context Guidance: Learning Inter-Task Synergies via Numerical Foundational Models for Few-Shot Multitask Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.25836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-task optimization (MTO) addresses a set of optimization tasks simultaneously, often suffering from inaccurate inter-task relationship estimation under limited evaluation budgets, leading to negative transfer. This paper introduces In-Context Guidance Multitask Optimization (ICG-MTO), a novel framework that leverages numerical foundational models to improve inter-task coupling estimation in few-shot scenarios. Unlike conventional methods that rely solely on scarce observed data, ICG-MTO employs a frozen foundational model to infer auxiliary guidance through in-context learning. The framework operates through three stages: constructing an algorithm-specific in-context query from evaluated solutions, using the foundational model to infer a guidance signal characterizing predictive relationships among tasks, and translating this signal into algorithm-specific guidance for maximum-a-posteriori coupling estimation. translated_title: 上下文引导：基于数值基础模型学习任务间协同效应的少样本多任务优化方法
translated_abstract: 多任务优化（MTO）需要同时求解一组优化任务，在有限评估预算的条件下，任务间关系估计往往不准确，从而导致负迁移。本文提出了上下文引导多任务优化，这是一种新颖的框架，利用数值基础模型在少样本场景下改进任务间耦合估计。与仅依赖稀缺观测数据的传统方法不同，ICG-MTO采用冻结的基础模型，通过上下文学习推断辅助引导。该框架通过三个阶段运行：从已评估的解中构建算法特定的上下文查询，利用基础模型推断表征任务间预测关系的引导信号，并将该信号转化为算法特定的引导以进行最大后验耦合估计。这种方法提供了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ICG-MTO框架，利用冻结的数值基础模型通过上下文学习推断任务间引导信号，从而在少样本多任务优化中改进任务间耦合估计并避免负迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ICG-MTO, a framework that leverages a frozen numerical foundational model to infer inter-task guidance signals via in-context learning, improving inter-task coupling estimation and mitigating negative transfer in few-shot multitask optimization.
